name: rosetta-self-numbers
code:
use default

let limit = 1_030_000_000
let words = limit / 64 + 1
let generated = LIST[ulong](words + 1)

(0::words) |> each(_ => generated.add(0ul))

mark(value: int) is
    let word = value >> 6

    generated[word] = generated[word] | (1ul << (value & 63))
si

is_generated(value: int) -> bool =>
    (generated[value >> 6] & (1ul << (value & 63))) != 0ul

let digit_sum mut = 1

for value in 1::limit do
    let generator = value + digit_sum

    if generator <= limit then
        mark(generator)
    fi

    let trailing mut = value
    let change mut = 1

    while trailing % 10 == 9 do
        change = change - 9
        trailing = trailing / 10
    od

    digit_sum = digit_sum + change
od

self_numbers() -> Pipe[int] =>
    (1::limit) |> filter(value => !is_generated(value))

write_line("the first 50 self numbers:")

self_numbers()
    |> take(50)
    |> chunk(10)
    |> each(row => write_line(row |> map(value => "{value,5}") |> join("")))

write_line()

let hundred_millionth =
    self_numbers() |> skip(99_999_999) |> first_or_throw()

let verdict =
    if hundred_millionth == 1_022_727_208 then "confirmed" else "wrong" fi

write_line("the 100,000,000th self number: {hundred_millionth:N0}")
write_line("the conjecture that it is 1,022,727,208 is {verdict}")
